zh-CN.The first pass should produce a habit pl: 保存、打印、导出或删除之前先快速复盘。这个步骤可以提前发现拼写、数量、日期、文件、隐私和格式问题。
zh-CN.Once the plan is reviewed, save it with: Once the plan is reviewed, save it with the project or workflow record.
